lessons.title: Phụ lục Noun Phrase (1/3) — the number of hay the amount of?
lessons.titleEn: The number of vs. the amount of
objectives: Phân loại danh từ đếm được / không đếm được, chọn đúng the number of / the amount of
Dùng "the figure for + tên nước/đối tượng" (giới từ FOR) và "the percentage / proportion of" cho dữ liệu %
Chia đúng số ít cho chủ ngữ "the number / the amount / the percentage"
keyLanguage: The number of + N đếm được số nhiều + V số ít: the number of cars was…
The amount of + N không đếm được + V3: the amount of water consumed…
The percentage / proportion / rate of + N + V: the proportion of students who…
The figure for + [đối tượng]: the figure for Sweden was higher than that for Norway
Đếm được: people, students, cars, households, tourists · Không đếm được: water, electricity, oil, energy, waste, fast food

lines: Task 1 thường cung cấp một noun phrase trong tiêu đề/biểu đồ. Học sinh cần biến cụm đó thành một subject tự nhiên trong câu mô tả số liệu. Ba chiến lược trọng tâm: (1) the amount/number + V-ing/V3, (2) noun + of, (3) word form + synonym.

theory.title: 2. Cách 1 — THE AMOUNT / THE NUMBER + VERB

lines: Dùng THE AMOUNT OF với danh từ không đếm được và THE NUMBER OF với danh từ đếm được.

rows: the number of + plural N + V-ing/V3
the number of people using public transport
the amount of + uncountable N + V3
the amount of electricity consumed in the UK

lines: Countable: people, students, cars, households, tourists, employees…
Uncountable: water, electricity, oil, energy, waste, fast food…
**Correct:** The amount of electricity consumed in the UK increased.
**Incorrect:** The number of electricity consumed increased.
• COUNTABLE → the number of; UNCOUNTABLE → the amount of.
• people/students/cars/households → number.
• water/electricity/oil/energy/waste/fast food → amount.
• The amount of + object + V3 rất hữu ích: the amount of water consumed.
• The number of + people/things + V-ing/V3: the number of people using…, the number of cars sold…
• Nếu đề có consumption/production/use/ownership, thử noun + of.
• consumption → consumed; production → produced/generated; generation → generated.
• Không dùng synonym nếu làm thay đổi meaning.
• Không cố paraphrase mọi từ trong tiêu đề.
• Accuracy > vocabulary show-off.

lessons.title: Phụ lục Noun Phrase (2/3) — Ba chiến thuật biến đổi noun phrase
objectives: Chiến thuật 1: the amount/number of + N + V-ing/V3 (participle bổ nghĩa)
Chiến thuật 2: đổi "N + N" thành "the + noun + of + object" (fast food consumption → the consumption of fast food)
Chiến thuật 3: đổi word form + synonym hợp meaning (consumption → consumed → used/eaten)
keyLanguage: the number of cars sold in Japan · the amount of electricity consumed in the UK
the consumption of electricity · the use of public transport · the production of waste · the ownership of cars
consumption → consumed · production → produced/generated · use → used/using · ownership → owned
Synonym phải hợp meaning — không thay từ chỉ vì trông học thuật hơn

lines: Giữ noun gốc và chuyển cấu trúc thành noun + of + object.

rows: the import of oil / oil imports
the export of goods / goods exports
possessing (less natural in some Task 1 contexts)

lines: Lưu ý: synonym phải phù hợp meaning. Không thay từ chỉ vì nó “trông học thuật” hơn.

rows: The amount of fast food consumed in Vietnam increased.
The consumption of fast food in Vietnam increased.
The amount of fast food eaten in Vietnam increased.
The amount of electricity consumed in the UK increased.
The consumption of electricity in the UK increased.
The amount of electricity used in the UK increased.
The amount of water consumed by households decreased.
The consumption of water by households decreased.
The amount of water used by households decreased.
The number of cars owned in Australia increased.
The number of people owning cars in Australia increased.
The number of people using public transport in London increased.
The use of public transport in London increased.
The number of people travelling by public transport in London increased.
The number of young people shopping online increased.
Online shopping among young people increased.
The number of young people purchasing goods online increased.
The amount of waste produced by factories increased.
The production of waste by factories increased.
The amount of waste generated by factories increased.

lines: Trong “The amount of fast food consumed in Vietnam increased”, “consumed in Vietnam” là past-participle phrase bổ nghĩa cho “fast food”. Có thể hiểu tương đương về nghĩa với “fast food which was consumed in Vietnam”.
**Countable:** The number of people using public transport increased.
**Passive:** The number of cars sold in Japan declined.
**Uncountable + passive:** The amount of waste produced by factories increased.

lessons.title: Phụ lục Noun Phrase (3/3) — Paraphrase tiêu đề biểu đồ & sửa lỗi
objectives: Quy trình: tìm head noun → đổi word form → xây noun phrase → đưa vào câu
Paraphrase tiêu đề biểu đồ giữ nguyên meaning, không word-by-word
Tự sửa lỗi countability, word form, "There were + %", "the figure of" → "the figure for"
keyLanguage: Fast food consumption in Vietnam, 2000–2020 → the amount of fast food consumed in Vietnam between 2000 and 2020
Accuracy first, variation second — không cố paraphrase mọi từ
Checklist: head noun? number vs amount? danh từ số nhiều sau number? V3/V-ing bổ nghĩa đúng noun? collocation tự nhiên?

rows: the number of cars sold in Japan

theory.title: PHẦN VII — CHECKLIST TRƯỚC KHI NỘP BÀI

rows: Tôi đã tìm head noun chưa?
Tôi có nhầm number và amount không?
Danh từ sau number có ở dạng plural không?
V3/V-ing có đang bổ nghĩa đúng noun không?
Meaning có giữ nguyên so với đề không?
Tôi có đang cố thay synonym từng từ không?
Câu có quá phức tạp chỉ để “show off” không?
Task 1: accuracy đã được ưu tiên chưa?
